Enum Class Direction

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Direction>
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.shared.enums.Direction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Direction>, Constable
public enum Direction extends Enum<Direction>
Represents the four cardinal directions in the Galaxy Truckers game. This enum provides utility methods for direction manipulation, rotation, and calculating neighboring positions on a grid.

    • rotateDirectionMap

      public static <V> Map<Direction, V> rotateDirectionMap(Map<Direction, V> original, Direction from, Direction to)
      Rotates a map of direction-to-value pairs from one direction to another. This is useful for rotating component orientations in the game.
      Type Parameters:
      V - The type of values in the map
      Parameters:
      original - The original direction-to-value map
      from - The source direction
      to - The target direction
      Returns:
      A new map with rotated direction keys

    • getNeighbour

      public static Point getNeighbour(Point p, Direction direction)
      Gets the neighboring point in a specified direction from a given point. This is useful for grid-based navigation in the game.
      Parameters:
      p - The starting point
      direction - The direction to move
      Returns:
      A new point that is one unit away in the specified direction
